title: HarvestStat Africa v1.2 coverage index
description: One aggregated row per source FNID, crop product label, and season label. This table describes coverage of historical source records; it is not a suitability dataset.

fields.name: crop_label
fields.description: Exact product label from HarvestStat Africa v1.2; not taxonomically normalized.

fields.name: admin_2
fields.description: Empty when the source's literal 'none' value indicates no admin-2 name.

fields.name: season_name
fields.description: Source-reported season label; empty means the source field was blank.

fields.name: planting_year_min
fields.description: Minimum source planting_year among grouped rows; blank if missing.

fields.name: planting_months
fields.description: JSON array of distinct source planting_month values; [] if none.

fields.name: harvest_months
fields.description: JSON array of distinct source harvest_month values; [] if none.

fields.name: qc_flag_counts
fields.description: JSON object mapping source qc_flag values to grouped row counts.
